Panel 1 -- Dashboard\text{Dashboard}Dashboard
Description: The primary control panel of SNL documentation in the repository, containing entrances to most of the editors.
Contents: Six entity sections: Libraries Section\htmlData{name=Libraries_Section,kind=section,tree-path=1.0}{\texttt{Libraries Section}}Libraries Section, Entries Section\htmlData{name=Entries_Section,kind=section,tree-path=1.1}{\texttt{Entries Section}}Entries Section, Relationships Section\htmlData{name=Entry.ui.section.dashboard.relationships,kind=section,tree-path=1.2}{\texttt{Relationships Section}}Relationships Section, SNL Macros Section\htmlData{name=SNL_Macros_Section,kind=section,tree-path=1.3}{\texttt{SNL Macros Section}}SNL Macros Section, Entry Kinds Section\htmlData{name=Entry_Kinds_Section,kind=section,tree-path=1.4}{\texttt{Entry Kinds Section}}Entry Kinds Section, and SNL Macro Kinds Section\htmlData{name=Entry.ui.section.dashboard.macro-kinds,kind=section,tree-path=1.5}{\texttt{SNL Macro Kinds Section}}SNL Macro Kinds Section; plus graph and Infoview opening actions.
Can be opened by: run VS Code command SNL: Open Dashboard\htmlData{name=SNL_Open_Dashboard,kind=command,tree-path=2.0}{\texttt{SNL: Open Dashboard}}SNL: Open Dashboard

Panel 2 -- Infoview\text{Infoview}Infoview
Description: Reading surface with Libraries and selected-Library outline layers. It opens Library and Entry content without edit mode; every Entry body uses EntrySurface\htmlData{name=EntrySurface,kind=snl-concept,tree-path=0.0}{\texttt{EntrySurface}}EntrySurface, query-only macro lookup, workspace Macro Kind colors, and recursive source popovers.
Contents: Contains Infoview Libraries Layer\htmlData{name=Entry.ui.section.infoview.libraries,kind=section,tree-path=1.0}{\texttt{Infoview Libraries Layer}}Infoview Libraries Layer and Infoview Library Reading Layer\htmlData{name=Entry.ui.section.infoview.library-reading,kind=section,tree-path=1.1}{\texttt{Infoview Library Reading Layer}}Infoview Library Reading Layer.
Can be opened by: run VS Code command SNL: Open Infoview\htmlData{name=CommandTitle.snlDoc.openInfoview,kind=command,tree-path=2.0}{\texttt{SNL: Open Infoview}}SNL: Open Infoview
Demonstration image: not documented

Panel 3 -- Entry Infoview\text{Entry Infoview}Entry Infoview
Description: Dedicated per-Entry reading panel, opened directly or by Ctrl-clicking an Entry title. It renders one EntrySurface\htmlData{name=EntrySurface,kind=snl-concept,tree-path=0.0}{\texttt{EntrySurface}}EntrySurface through MacroDataDriver\htmlData{name=MacroDataDriver,kind=snl-concept,tree-path=0.1}{\texttt{MacroDataDriver}}MacroDataDriver, colors macros with the workspace palette, and supports recursive hover popovers\htmlData{name=Recursive_hover_popovers,kind=snl-concept,tree-path=0.2}{\texttt{recursive hover popovers}}recursive hover popovers for nested Entry and macro references.
Contents: Contains Entry Infoview Render Section\htmlData{name=Entry.ui.section.entry-infoview.entry-render,kind=section,tree-path=1.0}{\texttt{Entry Infoview Render Section}}Entry Infoview Render Section, Entry Infoview Context Section\htmlData{name=Entry.ui.section.entry-infoview.context,kind=section,tree-path=1.1}{\texttt{Entry Infoview Context Section}}Entry Infoview Context Section, Entry Infoview Dependencies Section\htmlData{name=Entry.ui.section.entry-infoview.dependencies,kind=section,tree-path=1.2}{\texttt{Entry Infoview Dependencies Section}}Entry Infoview Dependencies Section, and an edit action.
Can be opened by: run VS Code command snlDoc.openEntryInfoview <entryId>\htmlData{name=snlDoc.openEntryInfoview_entryId,kind=command,tree-path=2.0}{\texttt{snlDoc.openEntryInfoview <entryId>}}snlDoc.openEntryInfoview <entryId>
Demonstration image: not documented

Panel 4 -- Create Library\text{Create Library}Create Library
Description: Creates a new Library directory from its title and slug, including empty meta.json\htmlData{name=File.meta_json,kind=filesystem,tree-path=0.0}{\texttt{meta.json}}meta.json, graph.json\htmlData{name=File.graph_json,kind=filesystem,tree-path=0.1}{\texttt{graph.json}}graph.json, and counters.json\htmlData{name=File.counters_json,kind=filesystem,tree-path=0.2}{\texttt{counters.json}}counters.json files. Existing slugs are never overwritten.
Contents: Contains a Library title input and a submit action.
Can be opened by: run VS Code command SNL: Create Library\htmlData{name=CommandTitle.snlDoc.createLibrary,kind=command,tree-path=2.0}{\texttt{SNL: Create Library}}SNL: Create Library
Demonstration image: not documented
Text Input 4.1 -- Library Title Input\text{Library Title Input}Library Title Input
Title field used to derive the new Library slug.
Button 4.2 -- Create Library Submit Button\text{Create Library Submit Button}Create Library Submit Button
Pressing it will create a Library directory with metadata, graph, and counters files.
Panel 5 -- Edit Library\text{Edit Library}Edit Library
Description: The Library\htmlData{name=Library,kind=snl-concept,tree-path=0.0}{\texttt{Library}}Library detail/edit view. It retains the outline tree editor, Library counter tree, external-file synchronization, and Entry navigation; the outline now displays source structure metrics\htmlData{name=Source_structure_metrics,kind=snl-concept,tree-path=0.1}{\texttt{source structure metrics}}source structure metrics beside SNL Entries and blocks invalid references before host submission.
Contents: Contains Outline Section\htmlData{name=Outline_Section,kind=section,tree-path=1.0}{\texttt{Outline Section}}Outline Section, Counters Section\htmlData{name=Counters_Section,kind=section,tree-path=1.1}{\texttt{Counters Section}}Counters Section, slug/title inputs, title-update action, and an Infoview action.
Can be opened by: run VS Code command SNL: Edit Library\htmlData{name=CommandTitle.snlDoc.editLibrary,kind=command,tree-path=2.0}{\texttt{SNL: Edit Library}}SNL: Edit Library
Demonstration image: not documented
Section 5.1 -- Outline Section\text{Outline Section}Outline Section
The tree-view editor over the Library graph. Rows retain expand, navigate, copy-id, add-child/sibling, move, indent/outdent, delete, and reference-or-create actions; referenced SNL Entries can display source structure metrics\htmlData{name=Source_structure_metrics,kind=snl-concept,tree-path=0}{\texttt{source structure metrics}}source structure metrics, shared Button\htmlData{name=Button_component,kind=snl-concept,tree-path=1}{\texttt{Button}}Button behavior governs controls, and invalid ids are rejected or routed through explicit Entry creation.
Button 5.1.1 -- Move-Up Row Toolbar Button\text{Move-Up Row Toolbar Button}Move-Up Row Toolbar Button
An ↑ button in the row toolbar\htmlData{name=row_toolbar,kind=snl-concept,tree-path=0.0}{\texttt{row toolbar}}row toolbar of a tree-view editor\htmlData{name=tree-view_editor,kind=snl-concept,tree-path=0.1}{\texttt{tree-view editor}}tree-view editor; it is a no-op at position 0.
Pressing it will move the current tree row above its previous sibling within the same parent.
Button 5.1.2 -- Indent Row Toolbar Button\text{Indent Row Toolbar Button}Indent Row Toolbar Button
It is a no-op when there is no previous sibling.
Pressing it will move the current tree row under its previous sibling as the last child.
Button 5.1.3 -- Outdent Row Toolbar Button\text{Outdent Row Toolbar Button}Outdent Row Toolbar Button
It is a no-op at the root level.
Pressing it will move the current tree row after its parent as the next sibling.
Button 5.1.4 -- Delete Row Toolbar Button\text{Delete Row Toolbar Button}Delete Row Toolbar Button
There is no confirmation modal because the tree state is source-controlled.
Pressing it will delete the current tree row and its subtree.
Button 5.1.5 -- Add Child Row Toolbar Button\text{Add Child Row Toolbar Button}Add Child Row Toolbar Button
Pressing it will add a child below the current row.
Button 5.1.6 -- Add Sibling Row Toolbar Button\text{Add Sibling Row Toolbar Button}Add Sibling Row Toolbar Button
Pressing it will add a sibling after the current row.
Button 5.1.7 -- Move-Down Row Toolbar Button\text{Move-Down Row Toolbar Button}Move-Down Row Toolbar Button
Pressing it will move the current tree row below its next sibling.
Button 5.1.8 -- Library Entry Entrance\text{Library Entry Entrance}Library Entry Entrance
An Entry reference row.
Pressing it will open Edit Entry\htmlData{name=Entry.ui.panel.entry.edit,kind=panel,tree-path=1.0}{\texttt{Edit Entry}}Edit Entry for the referenced Entry.
Text Input 5.1.9 -- Library Entry Reference ID Input\text{Library Entry Reference ID Input}Library Entry Reference ID Input
Searches or types an Entry id to add to the Library outline.
Text Input 5.1.10 -- Library Entry Counter Selector\text{Library Entry Counter Selector}Library Entry Counter Selector
Selects a per-reference Counter override; empty uses the Entry Kind default.
Button 5.1.11 -- Reference or Create Entry Button\text{Reference or Create Entry Button}Reference or Create Entry Button
Pressing it will reference an existing Entry, or insert a pending stub and open Create Entry when unresolved.
Button 5.1.12 -- Add Root Entry Reference Button\text{Add Root Entry Reference Button}Add Root Entry Reference Button
Pressing it will start the add form at the Library outline root.
Button 5.1.13 -- Cancel Entry Reference Add Button\text{Cancel Entry Reference Add Button}Cancel Entry Reference Add Button
The outline remains unchanged.
Pressing it will close the inline Entry-reference add form.
Section 5.1.1 -- Entry Source Metrics (Library)\text{Entry Source Metrics (Library)}Entry Source Metrics (Library)
source structure metrics\htmlData{name=Source_structure_metrics,kind=snl-concept,tree-path=0}{\texttt{source structure metrics}}source structure metrics
Section 5.2 -- Counters Section\text{Counters Section}Counters Section
The tree editor over counters.json\htmlData{name=File.counters_json,kind=filesystem,tree-path=0}{\texttt{counters.json}}counters.json inside Edit Library. Each Counter has id, name, numbering, and children; Entry Kind defaults and per-occurrence overrides resolve into this Library-scoped hierarchy.
Text Input 5.2.1 -- Counter Numbering DSL Field\text{Counter Numbering DSL Field}Counter Numbering DSL Field
Typst-inspired numbering template stored on a Counter node. Examples include 1\htmlData{name=Literal.one,kind=literal,tree-path=0}{\texttt{1}}1, .1\htmlData{name=Literal.dot_one,kind=literal,tree-path=1}{\texttt{.1}}.1, A\htmlData{name=Literal.upper_A,kind=literal,tree-path=2}{\texttt{A}}A, (i)\htmlData{name=Literal.lower_i,kind=literal,tree-path=3}{\texttt{(i)}}(i), Ex. A.\htmlData{name=Literal.example_A,kind=literal,tree-path=4}{\texttt{Ex. A.}}Ex. A., and §I.\htmlData{name=Literal.section_I,kind=literal,tree-path=5}{\texttt{§I.}}§I.; formatting replaces the first ordinal slot for the Counter-local position.
Text Input 5.2.2 -- Counter Name Input\text{Counter Name Input}Counter Name Input
Inline Counter name field; Entry Kinds match their default counter name here.
Button 5.2.3 -- Add First Counter Button\text{Add First Counter Button}Add First Counter Button
This action is available when the Counter tree is empty.
Pressing it will add the first root Counter.
Button 5.2.4 -- Add Root Counter Button\text{Add Root Counter Button}Add Root Counter Button
This action is available when the Counter tree is non-empty.

Description: Panel\htmlData{name=Panel,kind=panel,tree-path=0.0}{\texttt{Panel}}Panel to author a single entry: id (manual with Generate UUID\htmlData{name=Generate_UUID,kind=button,tree-path=0.1}{\texttt{Generate UUID}}Generate UUID button), kind, title, and content across five format tabs (SNL, Typst, LaTeX, Markdown, plain). Description: Panel\htmlData{name=Panel,kind=panel,tree-path=0.0}{\texttt{Panel}}Panel for authoring a macro name, package, kind, descriptions, sources, tags, output backends, and strict Macro v7\htmlData{name=Macro_v7,kind=snl-concept,tree-path=0.1}{\texttt{Macro v7}}Macro v7 styles. Styles use style_name\htmlData{name=style_name,kind=snl-concept,tree-path=0.2}{\texttt{style\_name}}style_name, required tags, a four-way mode, and a template; dynamic styles edit text around a real #*\htmlData{name=Literal.hash_star,kind=literal,tree-path=0.3}{\texttt{\#*}}#* plus separator\htmlData{name=separator,kind=snl-concept,tree-path=0.4}{\texttt{separator}}separator, block styles choose block_template_name\htmlData{name=block_template_name,kind=snl-concept,tree-path=0.5}{\texttt{block\_template\_name}}block_template_name, and live preview resolves through MacroDataDriver\htmlData{name=MacroDataDriver,kind=snl-concept,tree-path=0.6}{\texttt{MacroDataDriver}}MacroDataDriver.
Contents: Contains Macro Styles Section (Create)\htmlData{name=Entry.ui.section.macro.create.styles,kind=section,tree-path=1.0}{\texttt{Macro Styles Section (Create)}}Macro Styles Section (Create), Macro Live Preview Section (Create)\htmlData{name=Entry.ui.section.macro.create.preview,kind=section,tree-path=1.1}{\texttt{Macro Live Preview Section (Create)}}Macro Live Preview Section (Create), Macro Sources Section (Create)\htmlData{name=Entry.ui.section.macro.create.sources,kind=section,tree-path=1.2}{\texttt{Macro Sources Section (Create)}}Macro Sources Section (Create), Macro Tags Section (Create)\htmlData{name=Entry.ui.section.macro.create.tags,kind=section,tree-path=1.3}{\texttt{Macro Tags Section (Create)}}Macro Tags Section (Create), macro name/kind/description inputs, create-kind action, and submit action.
Can be opened by: run VS Code command SNL: Create Macro\htmlData{name=CommandTitle.snlDoc.createMacro,kind=command,tree-path=2.0}{\texttt{SNL: Create Macro}}SNL: Create Macro
Demonstration image: not documented

SNL macro name field.

Selects the SNL Macro Kind.
Section 15.1 -- Macro Styles Section (Create)\text{Macro Styles Section (Create)}Macro Styles Section (Create)
Edits strict Macro v7\htmlData{name=Macro_v7,kind=snl-concept,tree-path=0}{\texttt{Macro v7}}Macro v7 styles: style_name\htmlData{name=style_name,kind=snl-concept,tree-path=1}{\texttt{style\_name}}style_name, mode, template, required tags, optional separator\htmlData{name=separator,kind=snl-concept,tree-path=2}{\texttt{separator}}separator, and block-only block_template_name\htmlData{name=block_template_name,kind=snl-concept,tree-path=3}{\texttt{block\_template\_name}}block_template_name.
Text Input 15.1.1 -- Macro Template Input (Create)\text{Macro Template Input (Create)}Macro Template Input (Create)
Macro v7 template for one style. Fixed macros use numbered positional placeholders; dynamic macros contain a real #*\htmlData{name=Literal.hash_star,kind=literal,tree-path=0}{\texttt{\#*}}#* joined by separator\htmlData{name=separator,kind=snl-concept,tree-path=1}{\texttt{separator}}separator.
Text Input 15.1.2 -- Macro Style Name Input (Create)\text{Macro Style Name Input (Create)}Macro Style Name Input (Create)
Edits style_name\htmlData{name=style_name,kind=snl-concept,tree-path=0}{\texttt{style\_name}}style_name for the selected style. The value is required, unique within the macro, and determines the bracket selector used by SNL source.
Text Input 15.1.3 -- Dynamic Template Left Input (Create)\text{Dynamic Template Left Input (Create)}Dynamic Template Left Input (Create)
Edits the template text stored before the real #*\htmlData{name=Literal.hash_star,kind=literal,tree-path=0}{\texttt{\#*}}#* in a dynamic Macro v7 style.
Text Input 15.1.4 -- Dynamic Separator Input (Create)\text{Dynamic Separator Input (Create)}Dynamic Separator Input (Create)
Edits separator\htmlData{name=separator,kind=snl-concept,tree-path=0}{\texttt{separator}}separator, including an explicitly empty string, for children substituted at the dynamic placeholder.
Text Input 15.1.5 -- Dynamic Template Right Input (Create)\text{Dynamic Template Right Input (Create)}Dynamic Template Right Input (Create)
Edits the template text stored after the real #*\htmlData{name=Literal.hash_star,kind=literal,tree-path=0}{\texttt{\#*}}#* in a dynamic Macro v7 style.
Text Input 15.1.6 -- Block Template Name Input (Create)\text{Block Template Name Input (Create)}Block Template Name Input (Create)
Selects or customizes the block-only block_template_name\htmlData{name=block_template_name,kind=snl-concept,tree-path=0}{\texttt{block\_template\_name}}block_template_name used by the React renderer. The field is not serialized for non-block modes.
Text Input 15.1.7 -- Macro Mode Selector (Create)\text{Macro Mode Selector (Create)}Macro Mode Selector (Create)
Selects formula_inline, formula_display, text, or block mode for the active Macro v7 style.
Text Input 15.1.8 -- Dynamic Arity Toggle (Create)\text{Dynamic Arity Toggle (Create)}Dynamic Arity Toggle (Create)
Marks the macro dynamic and replaces the ordinary template editor with left, separator, and right controls serialized around a real #*\htmlData{name=Literal.hash_star,kind=literal,tree-path=0}{\texttt{\#*}}#*.

Pressing it will add a uniquely named Macro v7 style.

styles[0] is the implicit default.

Renders the draft macro with argument overrides.

Contents: Contains Entry Live Preview Section (Edit)\htmlData{name=Entry.ui.section.entry.edit.preview,kind=section,tree-path=1.0}{\texttt{Entry Live Preview Section (Edit)}}Entry Live Preview Section (Edit), Entry Content Section (Edit)\htmlData{name=Entry.ui.section.entry.edit.content,kind=section,tree-path=1.1}{\texttt{Entry Content Section (Edit)}}Entry Content Section (Edit), Contributor Section (Edit Entry)\htmlData{name=Entry.ui.section.entry.edit.contributor,kind=section,tree-path=1.2}{\texttt{Contributor Section (Edit Entry)}}Contributor Section (Edit Entry), Pointer Section (Edit Entry)\htmlData{name=Entry.ui.section.entry.edit.pointer,kind=section,tree-path=1.3}{\texttt{Pointer Section (Edit Entry)}}Pointer Section (Edit Entry), Entry id/title/kind/content inputs, Infoview action, and submit action.
Can be opened by: run VS Code command SNL: Edit Entry\htmlData{name=CommandTitle.snlDoc.editEntry,kind=command,tree-path=2.0}{\texttt{SNL: Edit Entry}}SNL: Edit Entry
Demonstration image: not documented
Text Input 21.1 -- Entry ID Field (Edit)\text{Entry ID Field (Edit)}Entry ID Field (Edit)
Read-only stable Entry id.
Text Input 21.2 -- Entry Title Field (Edit)\text{Entry Title Field (Edit)}Entry Title Field (Edit)
Editable Entry title.
Text Input 21.3 -- Entry Kind Selector (Edit)\text{Entry Kind Selector (Edit)}Entry Kind Selector (Edit)
Selects the Entry Kind.
Text Input 21.4 -- Entry Content Editor (Edit)\text{Entry Content Editor (Edit)}Entry Content Editor (Edit)
Edits SNL, Typst, LaTeX, Markdown, or plain content.
Button 21.5 -- View Entry in Infoview Button\text{View Entry in Infoview Button}View Entry in Infoview Button
Pressing it will open Entry Infoview\htmlData{name=Entry_Infoview,kind=panel,tree-path=0.0}{\texttt{Entry Infoview}}Entry Infoview for the current Entry.
Section 21.1 -- Entry Live Preview Section (Edit)\text{Entry Live Preview Section (Edit)}Entry Live Preview Section (Edit)
Live edit preview rendered through the shared EntrySurface\htmlData{name=EntrySurface,kind=snl-concept,tree-path=0}{\texttt{EntrySurface}}EntrySurface, workspace MacroDataDriver\htmlData{name=MacroDataDriver,kind=snl-concept,tree-path=1}{\texttt{MacroDataDriver}}MacroDataDriver, Macro Kind palette, and recursive hover popovers\htmlData{name=Recursive_hover_popovers,kind=snl-concept,tree-path=2}{\texttt{recursive hover popovers}}recursive hover popovers stack used by final Entry surfaces.
Section 21.2 -- Entry Content Section (Edit)\text{Entry Content Section (Edit)}Entry Content Section (Edit)
Five-format Entry content editor in edit mode.
Button 21.2.1 -- SNL Content Tab (Edit)\text{SNL Content Tab (Edit)}SNL Content Tab (Edit)
This applies to the existing Entry.
Pressing it will select the SNL content editor.
Button 21.2.2 -- Typst Content Tab (Edit)\text{Typst Content Tab (Edit)}Typst Content Tab (Edit)
This applies to the existing Entry.
Pressing it will select the Typst content editor.
Button 21.2.3 -- LaTeX Content Tab (Edit)\text{LaTeX Content Tab (Edit)}LaTeX Content Tab (Edit)
This applies to the existing Entry.
Pressing it will select the LaTeX content editor.
Button 21.2.4 -- Markdown Content Tab (Edit)\text{Markdown Content Tab (Edit)}Markdown Content Tab (Edit)
This applies to the existing Entry.
Pressing it will select the Markdown content editor.
Button 21.2.5 -- Text Content Tab (Edit)\text{Text Content Tab (Edit)}Text Content Tab (Edit)
This applies to the existing Entry.
Pressing it will select the Text content editor.
Button 21.2.6 -- SNL Text Editor Button (Edit)\text{SNL Text Editor Button (Edit)}SNL Text Editor Button (Edit)
This applies to the existing Entry.
Pressing it will switch SNL content to the text editor.
Button 21.2.7 -- SNL GUI Editor Button (Edit)\text{SNL GUI Editor Button (Edit)}SNL GUI Editor Button (Edit)
This applies to the existing Entry.
Pressing it will switch SNL content to GUI inductive editor\htmlData{name=GUI_inductive_editor,kind=section,tree-path=1.1}{\texttt{GUI inductive editor}}GUI inductive editor.
Section 21.2.1 -- GUI Inductive Editor Section (Edit Entry)\text{GUI Inductive Editor Section (Edit Entry)}GUI Inductive Editor Section (Edit Entry)
Edit-mode Tree v2 editor with the same query-driven macro resolution and stable row identity.
Text Input 21.2.1.1 -- GUI Macro Style Input (Edit Entry)\text{GUI Macro Style Input (Edit Entry)}GUI Macro Style Input (Edit Entry)
Edits the Tree v2 style_name and serializes an explicit bracketed style only when authored.
Button 21.2.1.2 -- Open Macro Editor Button (Edit Entry)\text{Open Macro Editor Button (Edit Entry)}Open Macro Editor Button (Edit Entry)
Pressing it will open either Create Macro\htmlData{name=Create_Macro,kind=panel,tree-path=0.0}{\texttt{Create Macro}}Create Macro for the current GUI tree row with macro_name, env_mode, and style_name context or Edit Macro\htmlData{name=Edit_Macro,kind=panel,tree-path=0.1}{\texttt{Edit Macro}}Edit Macro for the current GUI tree row with macro_name, env_mode, and style_name context.
Section 21.3 -- Contributor Section (Edit Entry)\text{Contributor Section (Edit Entry)}Contributor Section (Edit Entry)
Edits Entry contribution metadata.
Section 21.4 -- Pointer Section (Edit Entry)\text{Pointer Section (Edit Entry)}Pointer Section (Edit Entry)
Edits the Entry source pointer metadata.
Button 21.6 -- Update Entry Submit Button\text{Update Entry Submit Button}Update Entry Submit Button
Pressing it will validate and update the existing Entry.

Section .1 -- Shared Panel Navigation\text{Shared Panel Navigation}Shared Panel Navigation
Shared navigation mounted by the Extension editor and list panels. It provides refresh plus a contextual route back to Dashboard or Infoview and uses the common webview message bridge.
Button .1.1 -- Back to Dashboard Button\text{Back to Dashboard Button}Back to Dashboard Button
Navigation uses the shared nav.openDashboard message.
Pressing it will navigate back to Dashboard\htmlData{name=Dashboard,kind=panel,tree-path=1.0}{\texttt{Dashboard}}Dashboard.
Button .1.2 -- Back to Infoview Button\text{Back to Infoview Button}Back to Infoview Button
From Relationship Graph, navigation uses the shared nav.openInfoview message.
Pressing it will navigate back to Infoview\htmlData{name=Infoview,kind=panel,tree-path=1.0}{\texttt{Infoview}}Infoview.
Button .1.3 -- Refresh Panel Button\text{Refresh Panel Button}Refresh Panel Button
The request uses nav.refresh; host file watchers can refresh the same panel automatically.
Pressing it will refresh the current panel context.
